params.body:
On the laptop, `hand.mjs workingset` signed the set and then failed: "No way to Portal: no token". The laptop holds no Portal token since 5 October 2026, by design.

- **`keepWorkingSet()`** posts straight to `POST /api/ingest/working-set` without a token, because the signature is the proof (Portal side, separate PR).
- **The signed set is saved first** to `~/.config/control/working-set.json` (0600). If Portal does not answer, `hand.mjs workingset --resend` delivers the same signature again, without a second PIN and touch.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

params.title: Deliver a working set without a Portal token, and resend it without signing again
